item.title: Mexico investigates video said to show cartel members fighting for Ukraine
item.description: Mexico is investigating a viral video showing suspected mercenaries chanting cartel slogans while fighting in Ukraine.

item.title: Trump confirms Fort Hood shooter’s execution will be by firing squad
item.description: The Pentagon said the firing squad execution of Fort Hood shooter Nidal Malik Hasan will be public and livestreamed.

item.title: US judge rules Trump administration’s use of voter data unlawful
item.description: A federal judge ruled against the Justice Department's use of voter data to cross-reference an immigration database.

item.title: Africa Cup of Nations may stay as a biennial event, says CAF chief Motsepe
item.description: CAF had declared the Africa Cup of Nations would be held every four years, but may reverse that decision.

item.title: Manchester United vs Tottenham: Premier League – teams, prediction, lineups
item.description: Man United and Tottenham Hotspur managers under increasing pressure ahead of Premier League clash at Old Trafford.

item.title: UN envoy warns Yemen has returned to ‘full-scale war’, urges dialogue
item.description: Saudi Arabia and Yemen's internationally recognised gov't urge UN Security Council action amid Houthi escalation.

item.title: How will Spain’s housing crisis affect elections?
item.description: Snap vote called after Parliament rejects measures to protect tenants and freeze rents.

item.title: Human rights veteran Navi Pillay wins 2026 Nobel Peace Prize
item.description: South African jurist Navanethem Pillay has been awarded the 2026 Nobel Peace Prize for her work to promote peace.

item.title: Rising fuel costs slashed Delta’s profit outlook despite strong demand
item.description: Rising fuel prices push Delta's annual fuel expenses up by $6bn, affecting its profit outlook for 2026.

item.title: Flydubai co-pilot plotted ‘suicide’ attack on Israel, UAE says
item.description: Attorney General says suspect admitted he acted alone after preparing ‌‌psychologically ‌‌and physically for the attack.

item.title: Trump announces Russian diesel deal amid soaring US fuel prices
item.description: Russia to supply 300,000 tonnes of diesel immediately, followed by 1.5 million more, as prices soar amid the Iran war.

item.title: European states, Canada, Japan and UN back ICC against US sanctions
item.description: Several US allies call to 'defend' and 'protect' the ICC following Washington's decision to sanction the judiciary body.

item.title: Panama earthquake: Tsunami warnings issued after magnitude 7.7 quake
item.description: Countries including Colombia, Ecuador, Nicaragua, Guatemala and Chile have received warnings after the quake.

item.title: Injured Orangutan rescued from Indonesia wildfires
item.description: A young orangutan has been rescued from wildfires on Borneo Island in Indonesia.

item.title: Katie Zacharia selected to be next White House press secretary
item.description: US President Donald Trump called the conservative commentator 'a devoted fan'.

item.title: ‘Barbaric’: US lawmakers condemn plan to livestream Nidal Hasan’s execution
item.description: Republican and Democratic lawmakers condemn Pentagon plan to livestream Fort Hood shooter's execution by firing squad.

item.title: AI deepfake ads grow more popular in US midterm campaigns, blurring truth
item.description: The US midterm election campaign has been filled with political ads featuring AI deepfakes that can mislead voters.

item.title: Gaza ceasefire ‘exists in name only’, more than 100 NGOs say
item.description: Humanitarian and human rights groups call out Israel's continued killings and restrictions across the enclave.

item.title: ‘An attack against sovereign states’: ICC President slams US sanctions
item.description: International Criminal Court President Tomoko Akane has responded to US sanctions imposed to ‘defend sovereignty’.

item.description: A US charity announced it will use an AI-software to monitor Gaza classrooms for ‘anti-Semitism’ and ‘hate speech’.

item.title: Drone strike kills 30 people in Sudan’s Blue Nile region
item.description: Drone reportedly linked to RSF targets Wad al-Mahi, killing dozens near displacement camp, including women and children.

item.title: Palestinians seek protection from violent settlers during olive harvest
item.description: Palestinian farmers harvesting olives in the occupied West Bank are calling on international activists to protect them.

item.title: Powerful tornado rips through western Sicily
item.description: A powerful tornado tore through western Sicily, causing destruction across the cities of Marsala and Petrosino.

item.title: DHS defends ICE shooting in NYC, says officers believed they were in danger
item.description: The shooting prompted protests in New York City and Mayor Zohran Mamdani condemned the incident.

item.description: Belarus-linked incidents trouble Latvia and Lithuania, where experts warn of security challenges.
